description: At Haircules, we prioritize hair health with natural ingredients like biotin, coconut oil, and melatonin. Our matte paste offers a firm, no-shine hold while promoting stronger hair. Perfect for all hair types, it’s water-based, leaving your hair soft, refreshed, and styled all day with a subtle, fresh fragrance. Our formula is designed to keep your hair looking clean and polished, both while you wear it and after it’s washed out. We focused on eliminating any white residue, so you get a flawless finish without the hassle. Plus, it’s super easy to rinse out, making your hair care routine effortless.
